_doc: Engine schema for 'Happy Birthday, Ada' (Cozy Chores Open House, GDD sections 4-5). Coordinates are % of the 4:5 stage (x, w of its width; y, h of its height). Words the learner reads or hears come from content/cake.json (farin-lxd) through line roles: a role 'tin' in station 'bake' is the line whose id ends in '.bake.tin' in the current band's variant. Roles missing at a band are skipped. Strings marked 'lxd-review' were written by farin-app and wait for farin-lxd. Keep the top-right corner (x > 80 %, y < 12 %) free of anything interactive: the order note sits there on phones.

objects._doc: lxd-review: target words + glosses for the A1 picture+word labels and the words spoken when an item is picked up.

recipe._doc: lxd-review: the recipe card rows (live HTML on the paper). kind count = a number word, mass = 'some'; the two kinds are coloured differently (content-chores-ada-cake.md change 8).

notes._doc: lxd-review: order-note entries the content file does not carry.

cake._doc: The cake as the learner made it, drawn from memory: sponge, cream in the chosen colour, fruit on the rim, the piped words, candles. Local coordinates are % of the composite box (a square).

co-bell-regatta-photo.name: framed photo: young Mrs Bell, regatta 1970
co-bell-regatta-photo.desc: a small framed photo by the till: Mrs Bell aged 17 waving a flag on the harbour wall at the 1970 regatta (no spoiler of Case Closed)

co-captain-bowl.name: Captain’s bowl (CAPTAIN painted on it)
co-captain-bowl.desc: an enamel cat bowl with CAPTAIN painted on it (the word is live HTML in the stand-in)

picturedBy._doc: The table in GDD 13.10, per language; pictured above is their union (labels are the same in both apps). oh-lint.mjs checks these.
